name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source time tracker for freelancers and agencies with projects, clients, billable rates and reports, backed by PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Registration is off. After the first deploy, open a terminal in the solidtime service and run: php artisan admin:user:create "Your Name" "you@example.com" --verify-email. It prints the generated password. Add that email to SUPER_ADMINS to unlock the /admin panel. To allow sign-ups instead, set APP_ENABLE_REGISTRATION to on or invite-only.
Emails are only written to the log. Set MAIL_MAILER to smtp and fill in the MAIL_* variables to send invitations and password resets.
